Our story

Pure vegetarian, cooked like home.

VAAV Kitchen and Caterers is a pure vegetarian caterer for weddings, upanayanams and corporate events across Chennai. We cook with organic ingredients, so every dish is as wholesome as it is festive — traditional Pure Vegetarian Home Food, made to be trusted.

Ground spices, cold-pressed oil, no shortcuts. We cook fresh the same day so the sambar reaches your leaf hot — exactly as it should, whether it's a 30-guest housewarming or a 2,000-plate wedding.
